candidates.exact_span:
SECTION II. REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIC TO SURFACE DISPOSAL SITES WITHOUT A LINER
AND LEACHATE COLLECTION SYSTEM.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a site qualifies as a surface disposal site without a liner and leachate collection system determines whether the pollutant limits and associated requirements in this section are operative at all.

candidates.exact_span:
1. Pollutant limits - Sewage sludge shall not be applied to a surface disposal site if the
      concentrations of the listed pollutants exceed the corresponding values based on the surface
      disposal site boundary to the property line distance:
candidates.computation_change_reason: This clause ties enforceable numeric pollutant limits to measured boundary-to-property-line distance; different distance measurement or site-boundary interpretation changes which limit values apply and whether application is prohibited.

candidates.exact_span:
Table 5
       Unit boundary to property line                 Pollutant concentrations* (mg/kg)
       distance (meter)                     Arsenic        Chromium        Nickel       PCB’s
       0 to < 25                              30              200           210          49
       25 to < 50                             34              220           240          49
       50 to < 75                             39              260           270          49
       75 to < 100                            46              300           320          49
       100 to < 125                           53              360           390          49
       125 to < 150                           62              450           420          49
       ≥ 150                                  73              600           420          49
candidates.computation_change_reason: Each distance tier assigns different numeric concentration limits for arsenic, chromium, nickel, and PCBs; assigning a site to a different tier changes the applicable enforceable limits and any exceedance determination.
Whether pollutant concentrations are evaluated on a dry-weight basis versus another basis changes the numeric comparison against Table 5 limits.
